question.text: Which of the following is a PASSIVE fixed-income strategy?

explanation.text: The Logic: Bond index funds replicate (mimic/mirror) a chosen benchmark and are described in the workbook as passive management. Rate-anticipation duration switching, barbell construction, and credit-spread bets are all active strategies that depart from a benchmark to add value. The Trap: Barbell sounds like a fixed "construction" rule, but it is an active maturity/curve bet, not a passive benchmark-mirroring approach. Note: Per pages 337-339, bond index funds/indexing are passive; pages 343-344 describe active duration and barbell strategies.
